title: Optimism — Wintermute Vanity Address Proxy Deployment Failure Analysis
loss_raw: 20,000,000 OP tokens temporarily taken — an unknown actor deployed to the vanity address and claimed the tokens, but returned all 20M OP to Wintermute after negotiations (~1 week). Net permanent loss: $0.
root_cause: Wintermute sent OP tokens to a vanity address (CREATE opcode-based) that was deployed on Ethereum but had never been deployed on Optimism. The PoC demonstrates that the address can be generated on Optimism by looping through ProxyFactory `createProxy()` calls
steps: [Mistake] Optimism Foundation → sends OP to Wintermute vanity address
→ Tokens locked at an address nobody controls yet
